h1: The 4 Best Samsung Tablets of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: four Samsung Galaxy tablets, from the Tab A11+ to the Tab S11 Ultra, compared on storage, screen size, stylus support and price.
summary: The Galaxy Tab S11 128GB is our best overall pick, pairing S Pen support with a flagship tier. The Tab A11+ 8GB is the value choice, the Tab S10 FE is the middle ground with stylus support, and the Tab S11 Ultra is the giant 14.6 inch option.
intro: Samsung sells tablets under confusingly similar names, and storage, RAM and 5G variants of the same model clutter the listings. Buying the wrong letter after Tab can change both price and screen size dramatically.

We ranked four distinct Samsung models and treated RAM, storage and 5G versions of the Tab A11+ as one model. Everything below is drawn from the listings, so confirm the exact configuration you are buying.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 128GB WiFi Android Tablet
products.verdict: The S-series pick with S Pen support and 128GB of storage.
products.description:
The Galaxy Tab S11 is a WiFi Android tablet with 128GB of storage and S Pen listed. It is in the $500+ tier.

It leads because stylus support at a standard size beats the A-series for notes and drawing. The tradeoff is a premium tier versus the cheaper A11+.

Choose it for note-taking, sketching and heavy daily use. If you only stream and browse, the cheaper A11+ is enough.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab A11+ 8GB RAM
products.verdict: A 256GB, 8GB RAM tablet in the $200-500 tier.
products.description:
The Tab A11+ in this listing has 8GB of RAM and 256GB of storage, at a $200-500 price.

It places second because it costs a tier less than the S11 and carries twice the storage. What it lacks is the S Pen listing of the S-series.

Buy it for streaming, reading and family use. The A11+ also appears in 6GB and 5G versions, so check which one you are ordering.

products.name: ist computers Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 FE Tablet
products.verdict: A 10.9 inch tablet with stylus support at a mid-range tier.
products.description:
The Tab S10 FE lists a 10.9 inch screen, 128GB of storage and stylus support, priced $200-500. This listing is from a reseller named ist computers.

It ranks third because the S11 is the stronger S-series model, while the A11+ has more storage. Its place is the middle: stylus support without a flagship price.

Choose it if you want a pen but not the $500+ tier. Check reseller terms before buying.
products.idealFor: Students who want a pen on a mid budget.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra Ai Wifi Model
products.verdict: A 14.6 inch, 256GB tablet for people who want a laptop-sized screen.
products.description:
The Tab S11 Ultra lists a 14.6 inch screen, 256GB of storage and 5G, in the $500+ tier. The listing title also says WiFi model, so confirm the version.

It ranks last for most buyers because the size and price are big commitments. Its advantage is screen area no other pick here offers.

Buy it for split-screen work and large-canvas drawing. It is awkward for one-handed reading.
products.idealFor: Multitaskers who want a laptop-sized screen.

whatMatters.detail: Samsung's S models are the higher tier, the A series is value-focused and FE sits between. It matters because the series sets stylus support and price. Read the model name carefully before ordering.
Storage is how much you can keep on the tablet. 128GB suits streaming, 256GB gives headroom for files and downloads. Look for the GB figure in the title.
S Pen or stylus support helps note-taking and drawing. It matters for students and artists. The listing names the pen or stylus support.
Screen size changes portability. A 10.9 inch tablet is easy to hold, and a 14.6 inch one acts like a laptop. Check the inch figure in the listing.
RAM, storage and 5G versions of one model sit side by side in the results. They are not interchangeable. Confirm RAM, storage and network type before buying.

faq.a: The Tab A11+ appears in several RAM, storage and 5G versions, which we counted as one model.

faq.q: Does the A11+ have a stylus?
faq.a: None is listed, so assume no.
Cellular data when away from WiFi. Several A11+ listings and the Ultra mention 5G.
At 14.6 inches it is laptop-sized, great for multitasking but harder to carry.

faq.q: Should I buy from a reseller?
faq.a: The S10 FE listing is from a reseller, so check its return and warranty terms.

faq.q: How much storage do I need?
faq.a: 128GB suits streaming, while 256GB gives room for files.

finalTake: The Galaxy Tab S11 is the best Samsung tablet for most people who want a pen and a premium feel. Take the Tab A11+ 8GB for value, the S10 FE for a middle path, and the Ultra only if you need the screen.
